question: Davis Cup is related with which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tennis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Davis Cup is the premier international team event in men's tennis.
 
• It is run by the International Tennis Federation (ITF) and Kosmos Holding and is contested annually between teams from competing countries
